Deine Mission
Du sorgst dafür, dass aus Daten belastbare Entscheidungen und funktionierende KI-Lösungen werden.
Bei Agentur Philipp entwickeln wir KI-Systeme für den Mittelstand, die echten Aufwand reduzieren: intelligente Dokumentenverarbeitung, Datenextraktion, RAG-Systeme, Prognosen und KI-Kollegen.
Dafür suchen wir einen Data Scientist, der Daten wirklich versteht. Du erkennst Muster, entwickelst saubere Daten- und Evaluierungslogiken und machst aus unstrukturierten Informationen belastbare Systeme, die im Arbeitsalltag unserer Kunden funktionieren.
Aufgaben
Deine Aufgaben
Du analysierst komplexe, strukturierte und unstrukturierte Daten aus echten Kundenprozessen.
Du entwickelst Datenmodelle, Features und Auswertungen für KI- und Automatisierungslösungen.
Du bereitest Daten auf, entwickelst ETL- und Datenpipelines und sorgst für belastbare Datenqualität.
Du entwickelst, vergleichst und evaluierst Machine-Learning- und LLM-Ansätze für konkrete Anwendungsfälle.
Du baust RAG-Systeme mit klarer Retrieval-Logik, Metadatenfiltern, Evaluation und nachvollziehbaren Qualitätsmetriken.
Du arbeitest an Dokumenten-KI, etwa PDF-Extraktion, OCR, Tabellen-, Layout- und Textanalyse.
Du entwickelst Daten- und Evaluierungssets, damit unsere Systeme nicht nur überzeugend wirken, sondern fachlich zuverlässig arbeiten.
Du visualisierst und erklärst Ergebnisse so, dass technische und nichttechnische Kolleginnen und Kollegen damit arbeiten können.
Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Engineering-Team zusammen, damit deine Lösungen produktiv eingesetzt werden können.
Qualifikation
Das bringst du mit
Sehr gute Python-Kenntnisse und sichere Erfahrung mit Pandas, SQL und gängigen Data-Science-Werkzeugen.
Praktische Erfahrung mit Datenanalyse, Datenaufbereitung und ETL- oder ELT-Pipelines.
Erfahrung mit Machine Learning, statistischer Modellierung oder LLM-basierten Datenanwendungen.
Erfahrung mit RAG-Systemen, Embeddings, Vektordatenbanken, Retrieval und Evaluation.
Du verstehst Datenqualität, Fehlerbilder und die Grenzen von Modellen. Du überprüfst Ergebnisse, statt ihnen blind zu vertrauen.
Erfahrung mit APIs, relationalen Datenbanken und unstrukturierten Datenformaten wie PDFs, JSON oder Textdaten.
Du arbeitest strukturiert, dokumentierst sauber und kannst deine Entscheidungen verständlich begründen.
Du übernimmst Verantwortung und denkst vom echten Kundennutzen aus.
Das ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss
Erfahrung mit Dokumenten-KI, OCR, Information Extraction oder Tabellenextraktion.
Erfahrung mit Computer Vision oder multimodalen Modellen.
Erfahrung mit Docker, FastAPI, MLflow, Cloud-Plattformen oder lokalen KI-Stacks.
Erfahrung mit datenschutzsensiblen Daten und On-Premise-Umgebungen.
Deutschkenntnisse sind hilfreich, aber kein K.O.-Kriterium. Unser Team arbeitet auch auf Englisch.

Was dich bei uns erwartet
Keine theoretischen Datenprojekte ohne Wirkung. Du arbeitest an Lösungen, die bei Kunden produktiv eingesetzt werden.
Anspruchsvolle Anwendungsfälle rund um Dokumentenverarbeitung, KI-Kollegen, RAG und Prozessautomatisierung.
Viel Gestaltungsspielraum und kurze Entscheidungswege.
Direkter Kontakt zu den Menschen, die Entscheidungen treffen. Wenig Politik, schnelle Umsetzung.
Ein Team mit hohem fachlichen Anspruch und bodenständiger Zusammenarbeit.
Remote-freundliches Arbeiten mit regelmäßigem persönlichem Austausch in Dingolfing. Für die finale Gesprächsrunde möchten wir dich vor Ort kennenlernen.
Über Agentur Philipp
Agentur Philipp ist eine KI-Umsetzungsberatung für den Mittelstand. Wir beraten nicht nur, sondern bauen Systeme, die im Alltag funktionieren, Aufwand reduzieren und einen messbaren Unterschied machen.
Unsere Haltung ist klar: Wirkung, Durchziehen, Verstehen, Weiterdenken und Besser werden.
Klingt nach dir?
Dann schick uns deinen Lebenslauf, GitHub-, Portfolio- oder Projektlinks und gern eine kurze Beschreibung eines Projekts, auf das du fachlich stolz bist. Wichtig ist uns nicht, dass dein Lebenslauf perfekt aussieht. Wichtig ist, dass du zeigen kannst, wie du Daten in belastbare Ergebnisse und funktionierende Lösungen übersetzt.
Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

The Antitrust Division (ATR) is seeking highly qualified candidates to fill Data Scientist (DIRECT HIRE) positions in the Economic Analysis Group (EAG), Economic Policy Section (ELS). EAG is one of the world's leading venues for developing and applying economics to real world questions of competition.

Selectees will work alongside Ph.D. economists to identify, specify, process, verify, and analyze complex data produced to the Division in the course of its investigations and litigations.

Data relied upon most often comes from structured, relational databases, but can vary widely to include unstructured data and large, flat-file repositories of high-frequency data.

The right candidate will have the ability to think flexibly about how to extract and transform data, particularly when those data arrive in unfamiliar and unexpected formats, to enable the complex investigations that define the Antitrust Division's core mission.

The Data Scientists hired will play a vital role in developing the kind of evidence that plays a central role in enforcement efforts to protect competition and benefit consumers through low prices, high quality, product choice, and innovation.

As a Data Scientist (DIRECT HIRE), you will: Collaborate with Division economists and e-Discovery experts on which data and supporting documentation to demand of parties and the formats in which to receive those data.

Collaborate with Division economists and attorneys to formulate timely and precise written communication concerning databases and documentation, including identifying data most relevant to an investigation and determining how to best request and obtain such data from outside parties.

Engage with database specialists and attorneys representing outside parties. Work with the Division's Technology Directorate on hardware, software, and network resources. Assesses how to best organize data for analysis in both local and cloud environments.

Coordinate with the Division's Technology Directorate and economists to seamlessly roll out upgrades and new features. Prepare clear, high-quality graphical presentations of data utilizing summary tables, maps, and visual aids that effectively communicate insights from data to be presented to Division attorneys, economists, and senior management.

Apply statistical theory, methods, and techniques in performing critical analysis and evaluation of structured data received by parties in response to mergers.

Performs a variety of data manipulation tasks to support model development, including data cleaning, data summaries, diagnostics for model assessment, model evaluation, model selection, running simulation algorithms, and organizing simulation data.

Organize and manipulate large data sets, including spatial data, and runs computer-based simulation models, performs statistical analyses, and graphically summarizes model output data with summary statistics. Develop computer programs to perform analysis of statistical data and findings.

Use structured query language (SQL) queries and other tools to compile, clean, characterize, and extract data for both vetting the productions of outside parties and preparing those productions for investigatory analysis.

Apply data analytics tools and languages such as Python, PySpark, R, SparkR, Databricks, Snowflake, Stata, or SAS to collect and analyze data.

Use mapping software and other geospatial modeling tools to visualize information Performs other related duties as assigned Please note: Additional selections may be made beyond the total number of vacancies specified using this vacancy announcement.

Further selections may also be made for additional organizational divisions and/or units within the duty location(s) listed above.

Also, a writing sample and a combination of three to five business and academic references may be requested of individuals identified as best qualified, to be forwarded to the selecting official along with your application package, upon referral.

The degree must be in a major field of study (at least at the baccalaureate level) that is appropriate for the position. OR Combination of education and experience: Courses equivalent to a major field of study (30 semester hours) as shown in paragraph A above, plus additional education or appropriate experience.

AND SPECIALIZED EXPERIENCE: Specialized experience is experience that has provided you with the particular knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform successfully the duties of the position as described above, and that is typically in or related to this position being filled.

To qualify for this position at the GS-11 level, your resume must reflect at least one year of specialized experience equivalent to the GS-09 level.

GS-11 level: One full year of specialized experience, equivalent to the GS-09, performing ALL the following: Experience applying data analytic tools and languages such as SQL, Python, PySpark, R, SparkR, Stata, or SAS; and Experience assessing how to best organize data for analysis in both local and cloud environments.

An ideal candidate will also have the following experience: Experience using mapping software and geospatial modeling; and Experience communicating orally and in writing with professionals to discuss databases and documentation.

OR EDUCATION 3 full years of progressively higher-level graduate education leading to a Ph.D. degree OR PhD or equivalent doctoral degree OR COMBINATION OF EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE A combination of graduate level education beyond the second year of progressively higher graduate study and appropriate specialized experience.

IMPORTANT: A full year of work is 35-40 hours of work per week. All experience listed on your resume must include the month and year start/end dates. Part-time experience will be credited based on time spent in appropriate activities.

Applicants wishing to receive credit for such experience must clearly indicate the nature of their duties and responsibilities in each position and the number of hours a week spent in such employment. You must meet all qualification and eligibility requirements by the closing date of this announcement.

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:
Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.
Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.
Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.
Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

Join Vinted's Category Experience team, where we drive Vinted’s expansion into new categories and the improvement of existing ones. The team focuses on understanding, developing and expanding the structure of our catalog.

Select, calculate, and monitor key performance indicators and behavioural metrics, proactively flagging issues and uncovering insights through deeper analysis.
Collaborate with Taxonomists to enable them to use a data-driven approach to Taxonomy Design and category structure.
Support the Ontologies Platform (engineering) team to answer their data analytics questions.

Proven experience as a Decision Scientist, Data Analyst, or other role with a strong data component.
Experience with designing and running product experiments (A/B testing), knowledge of statistical modelling, probability theory (bonus: experience with causal inference methods).

Strong communicator who can convincingly present results to both technical and non-technical audiences.
